mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.5% signals accelerating economic activity, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals weakening manufacturing output, reducing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising federal funds rates.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% signals labor market weakness, reducing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising unemployment rates.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in retail sales (RSAFS) above 5% signals accelerating consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating retail sales.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.2 million signals weakening construction activity, reducing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining federal funds rates.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals labor market strength, boosting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining unemployment rates.
